overall.headline: Global EFB and Flight Planning Selections Show Diverse Carrier and Fleet Adoption
observations: Across **519** total airlines, **127** record EFB selections led by **AvioBook** (**21** of **127**, **16.5%**) and **In-house built** (**19** of **127**, **15.0%**).
Flight planning selections total **68** recorded entries, with **Lido** leading at **24** of **68** (**35.3%**) and **NavBlue** at **16** of **68** (**23.5%**).
Carrier-type and fleet contrasts indicate varied adoption, though missing data prevents universal categorization.
overall.caveat: Counts represent recorded selections rather than market share, and missing fields reflect unknown status rather than non-adoption.

regions.name: Europe & Central Asia
regions.headline: Regional EFB and Planning Show Strong In-House and Lido Presence
observations: In Europe & Central Asia (**151** airlines), **35** record EFB selections, led by **In-house built** (**7** of **35**, **20.0%**) and **AvioBook** (**6** of **35**, **17.1%**).
Planning selections total **14** recorded entries, featuring **Lido** (**5** of **14**, **35.7%**) and **FlightKeys** (**4** of **14**, **28.6%**).
Compared to the global rate, **FlightKeys** shows higher relative representation in this region.
regions.caveat: Missing fields are unknown, not non-adoption; metrics reflect recorded entries only.

regions.name: East Asia & Pacific
regions.headline: NavBlue and In-House Solutions Dominate Regional Recorded Selections
observations: East Asia & Pacific records **39** EFB selections from **130** airlines, led by **In-house built** (**9** of **39**, **23.1%**) and **Paper** (**6** of **39**, **15.4%**).
Planning selections total **18** entries, with **NavBlue** taking **9** of **18** (**50.0%**) and **Lido** taking **7** of **18** (**38.9%**).
**NavBlue** exceeds its global planning rate within this regional subset.
regions.caveat: Multi-select fields may count an airline more than once; unrecorded fields remain unknown.

regions.name: North America
regions.headline: North American Carriers Favor AvioBook and FlightKeys
observations: North America records **14** EFB selections across **59** airlines, led by **AvioBook** (**5** of **14**, **35.7%**) and **Navblue Mission+** (**3** of **14**, **21.4%**).
Planning selections total **9** entries, heavily weighted toward **FlightKeys** (**5** of **9**, **55.6%**).
**FlightKeys** displays a significantly higher selection rate here compared to the global baseline.
regions.caveat: Data points are limited by recorded field counts; missing data implies no proven negative adoption.

regions.name: Latin America & Caribbean
regions.headline: Balanced Regional Distribution Across Multiple EFB Vendors
observations: Latin America & Caribbean records **12** EFB selections from **56** airlines, featuring **AvioBook**, **Flightman**, and **Paper** each at **2** of **12** (**16.7%**).
Planning selections total **9** entries, led by **Lido** (**4** of **9**, **44.4%**).
**Lido** planning representation tracks slightly above the overall global selection rate.
regions.caveat: Aggregates reflect voluntary recorded selections and should not be generalized as complete market share.

regions.name: Middle East & North Africa
regions.headline: Bytron Skybook and Jeppesen Lead Regional EFB Selections
observations: Middle East & North Africa records **15** EFB selections from **51** airlines, led by **Bytron Skybook** (**3** of **15**, **20.0%**), **Jeppesen Aviator** (**3** of **15**, **20.0%**), and **Paper** (**3** of **15**, **20.0%**).
Planning selections total **10** entries, split evenly between **Lido** (**3** of **10**, **30.0%**) and **NavBlue** (**3** of **10**, **30.0%**).
Regional vendor distribution shows greater fragmentation than the global average.
regions.caveat: Unrecorded fields are unknown rather than indicative of lack of system usage.

regions.name: Sub-Saharan Africa
regions.headline: Limited Recorded Data Points Highlight IFS EFBOne and Lido
observations: Sub-Saharan Africa records **8** EFB selections from **47** airlines, with **IFS EFBOne** leading at **2** of **8** (**25.0%**).
Planning selections record **4** entries, led by **Lido** (**2** of **4**, **50.0%**).
Low overall recording density limits broad regional comparisons against global averages.
regions.caveat: Missing data restricts definitive conclusions about total market penetration.

regions.name: South Asia
regions.headline: South Asian Selections Spread Across Diverse EFB and Planning Tools
observations: South Asia records **4** EFB selections from **13** airlines, distributed among **AvioBook**, **In-house built**, **Navblue Mission+**, and **Paper** (each **1** of **4**, **25.0%**).
Planning selections total **4** entries, featuring **Lido** (**2** of **4**, **50.0%**) and **CAE** (**1** of **4**, **25.0%**).
Small sample sizes require cautious interpretation of vendor preference.
regions.caveat: Recorded counts represent sampled data and do not encompass all regional carriers.

Additional metadata mapping is required to assess adoption patterns.
